rationale: Candidate-exact supplemental NYC DOT project and public-board searches, together with inspection of the official Third Avenue project sources, found no statement binding X38 to the nine exact northbound feature rows, their 2025-12-16 onset, implementation phase, direction-specific traversal, or exact feature extent.
